verdict.rationale: CDP documents deposit destinations that can be provisioned as stable onchain addresses for customers or external parties and auto-credit a custodial account. The CDP SDK manages EVM and Solana wallets with CDP securing the private keys, alongside a non-custodial wallet mode where CDP handles signing, so both provisioning and custody models are described. missing for 10: explicit API reference for wallet creation and per-customer wallet mapping, in-depth key custody documentation (key management model, export/recovery), independent or hands-on corroboration.
